payload.description: A step-by-step guide to replacing the monthly FP&A grind with a repeatable Claude workflow. Covers setting up a Claude Project as your persistent FP&A workspace, loading a real planning model with actuals, spotting anomalies, updating forecasts, running scenario analysis, and saving the workflow so next month takes half the time. Based on Wouter Born's SaaS planning system — no code or API skills needed.
payload.name: How to Build a Monthly FP&A Planning System in Claude
